title: Opportunity stage transitions with an outbox (Fastify + Kysely)
scenario: pipeline-svc's stage-transition endpoint is the pipeline's most important write: the forecast consumes its OpportunityStageChanged events and the Keystone agent will call it through a tool, with retries. The CRM port works only in the demo: no transaction, no tenant, any stage, lost updates, events for changes that never committed, ad-hoc errors and requests killed on every rollout.
task: Zod validation and RFC 9457 problem+json for every error (400, 404, 409, 422, 500)
One transaction as the app role with the tenant set locally: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE, version check, transition graph and closed-won rules
Write stage_history and the outbox row in the same transaction; nothing written on rollback
Graceful shutdown: readiness 503, refuse new work, drain in-flight, then exit
acceptance: Concurrent transitions with one version: one 200, one 409, one outbox row
Other tenant's opportunity is a 404 and writes nothing
Failure before commit leaves no outbox row

practices.label: Week 4 Tue - Fastify schemas and Zod
Week 4 Wed - Kysely, transactions, FOR UPDATE, SET LOCAL
Week 4 Mon - Node event loop and graceful shutdown
Week 5 Tue - dual writes and the transactional outbox
